verdict.rationale: Deepgram has no native natural-language console or assistant for operating the platform. Its dg CLI does include a built-in MCP server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs, so a user can drive the product through natural language in an external AI client. Function calling and prompting shape how built agents behave in calls, which is not the same as operating the product. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface for managing account and agent configuration, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
